ALGER, 28 juillet 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: ALGIERS, July 28, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Djezzy shows progress in its financial and operational indicators over the first six months of 2026. The mobile operator achieves a turnover of 62.2 billion dinars, up 8.7% year-on-year.

L'opérateur mobile Djezzy a publié ses r: The mobile operator Djezzy has published its 2026 half-year results, revealing dynamic progress on all its key indicators. The turnover amounted to 62.2 billion dinars, an increase of 8.7% compared to the first half of 2025. This performance is accompanied by growth in the customer base, which now reached 18.1 million subscribers at the end of June 2026, marking an increase of 4.2% in one year.
Sur le plan opérationnel, l'EBITDA a pro: On the operational level, EBITDA increased by 6.6% to reach 26.7 billion dinars, maintaining a margin above 40%. These results illustrate good cost control and consolidated profitability. Management emphasizes that these figures are part of the company's annual roadmap.
